blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computing accurate geometry from multi-view images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. Recent feed-forward (FF) models jointly estimate 3D geometry and camera parameters, but they typically suffer from geometry distortion caused by reconstruction ambiguity, even when ground-truth camera parameters are supplied. In this paper, we study the multi-view stereo (MVS) problem with known camera parameters and propose a novel approach that bridges conventional MVS and FF methods. Rather than casting MVS as a sequence-to-one mapping that predicts depth only for a single reference view, we reformulate it as a sequence-to-sequence task, akin to FF models, that jointly predicts geometry for all input views. We introduce a global transformer-based architecture with two components that explicitly exploit camera-induced priors: ray-map embeddings that inject camera parameters into image patch tokens, making the transformer camera-aware, and a unified global cost volume that replaces conventional per-view cost volumes to jointly capture 3D structure across all views. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks show our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing both MVS and FF reconstruction baselines
blocks.zh: 从多视图图像中计算精确几何是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题. 最近的feed-forward(FF)模型联合估计了3D几何和相机参数,但它们通常受到重建模糊性导致的几何扭曲,即使提供了地面真实相机参数. 在本文中,我们用已知的相机参数研究多视图立体声(MVS)问题,并提出一种新颖的方法,将传统的MVS和FF方法连接起来. 与其将MVS铸成仅为单一参考视图预测深度的一对一映射,我们改编成一个序列到序列的任务,类似于FF模型,共同预测所有输入视图的几何. 我们采用了一个基于全球变压器的架构,有两个部分明确利用相机引起的前兆:将相机参数注入图像补丁符号的射线图嵌入,使变压器的相机-感知器,以及一个统一的全球成本量,取代常规的每景成本量,共同捕捉所有视图的3D结构. 对多种公共基准的广泛试验显示,我们的方法取得了最先进的业绩,超过了MVS和FF重建基线

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 3D reconstruction from multi-view images is a fundamental and long-standing problem in computer vision that has seen significant progress in recent years. Conventionally, the reconstruction task is addressed by Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-view Stereo (MVS), where both classical and learning-based methods have been developed. Classical methods [ 36 , 40 , 31 , 12 , 46 , 11 ] are able to reconstruct very accurate 3D points by extracting image correspondences and 3D triangulation. However, this often results in sparse and incomplete reconstructions, requiring complex densification techniques in post-processing [ 12 , 46 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 多视图图像的3D重建是计算机视觉中长期存在的一个根本性问题,近年来取得了显著进展. 在常规方面,重建任务由结构自动(SfM)和多视立体(MVS)来解决,两者都开发了古典和学习方法. 古典方法[36,40,31,12,46,11]能够通过提取图像对应和3D三角化来重建非常精确的3D点. 然而,这往往导致重建的稀少和不完整,需要在后处理中采用复杂的密度技术[12、46、11]。

blocks.en: Learning-based MVS methods [ 59 , 8 , 4 , 20 ] have been proposed to address this issue, leveraging deep learning to infer per-pixel dense depth maps directly from multi-view images. The key innovation of these methods is cost volumes as a camera-induced prior, which are constructed by regularly sampling 3D points along per-pixel depth dimension and store view-consistency information for each point. In this way, cost volumes offer very effective regularization for geometry estimation. Nevertheless, they are typically constructed on a per-view basis, effectively reducing the problem to a sequence-to-one formulation that predicts only the depth map of a reference view, even when multiple views are provided as input. The sequence-to-one design not only reduces efficiency but also restricts geometric estimation accuracy due to the lack of global alignment modeling.
blocks.zh: 为解决这一问题,提出了基于学习的MVS方法[59,8,4,20],利用深度学习从多视图图像直接推断出每像素密集深度图. 这些方法的关键创新是成本量作为相机引起的前置,通过按每像素深度维度定期取样3D点并存储每个点的视距一致性信息来构建. 这样,成本量为几何估算提供了非常有效的规范化. 尽管如此,它们通常都是按每个视图构建的,有效地将问题简化为只预测参考视图深度图的顺序对一的配方,即使提供了多种观点作为输入. 顺序对一设计不仅降低了效率,而且由于缺乏全球对齐模型,限制了几何估计精度.

blocks.en: Among the most notable advances in recent years are feed-forward (FF) models [ 52 , 57 , 56 , 23 , 27 , 53 , 2 ] designed for general settings and adopt a sequence-to-sequence formulation to jointly estimate camera parameters and depth/point maps for all input views. However, due to the inherent difficulty of this joint estimation problem, the resulting reconstructions are often less accurate or more distorted. This remains true even when ground-truth camera parameters are provided, as the model still attempts to estimate and update them.
blocks.zh: 近年来最显著的进步是,为一般环境设计了[52、57、56、23、27、53、2]向馈(FF)模型,并采用了顺序到顺序的表述,以便联合估计所有输入视图的相机参数和深度/点图。 然而,由于这一共同估计问题的固有困难,由此产生的重建往往不太准确或更扭曲。 即使在提供地面真实相机参数的情况下,情况也依然如此,因为模型仍在试图对其进行估计和更新。

blocks.zh: 图 1: 顺序对一的多视图立体法,我们提出的顺序对顺序多视图立体法和饲料前置重建法的配方差异.

blocks.en: In this paper, we study the MVS problem that conditions on known camera parameters. These parameters provide greater control over the reconstruction process and can be readily obtained in practice using SfM or other camera calibration methods. Our approach bridges MVS and FF methods: like feed-forward models, it adopts a sequence-to-sequence formulation with a global Transformer-based architecture, while incorporating camera-induced priors to ensure geometric accuracy. Specifically, we consider two types of such priors. Firstly and naturally, we need to incorporate camera parameters into the transformer-based architecture to make the model camera-aware. Secondly, we propose to adapt the conventional cost-volume idea to our sequence-to-sequence setting, providing valuable regularization over the underlying 3D scene geometry. We highlight the differences of our formulation and the existing ones in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们研究了在已知相机参数上的条件的MVS问题. 这些参数对重建过程提供了更大的控制,并且可以随时使用SfM或其他相机校准方法在实践中获得. 我们的方法将MVS和FF方法连接起来:它与向导模型一样,采用以全球变形器为基础的结构的顺序到序列的配制,同时纳入相机引起的前科以确保几何精确度。 具体地说,我们考虑了两类此类前科。 首先,我们自然需要将相机参数纳入基于变压器的架构中,使模型的相机意识. 第二,我们提议调整传统的成本-数量概念,使之适应我们从顺序到顺序的设定,为基本的三维场景几何提供宝贵的规范。 我们强调我们的措辞与图1的现有措辞之间的差异。

blocks.en: To integrate these priors into our framework, we introduce two key designs. First, inspired by [ 27 ] , we transform the camera intrinsics and extrinsics into ray maps, which are then tokenized and merged with image tokens to encode camera information. Second, we introduce a Global Cost Volume, which, unlike conventional cost volumes that have to be repeatedly constructed per-view, captures the global 3D structure of the scene across all views in a unified representation. We provide a diagram illustration of our method in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了把这些前科纳入我们的框架,我们提出了两个关键设计。 首先,受[27]的启发,我们把相机的内在和外显图转换成射线图,然后将相机作为标志并和图像符合并,以编码相机信息. 第二,我们引入了全球成本量,它与必须反复构建的常规成本量不同,它以统一代表方式捕捉了所有观点中场景的全球立体结构。 我们提供了图2中我们方法的图示。

blocks.en: Our model operates in a sequence-to-sequence manner, in contrast to existing sequence-to-one MVS methods that also incorporate camera-induced priors. Experimental results demonstrate that it achieves superior reconstruction results compared to both MVS approaches and recent sequence-to-sequence feed-forward models, establishing a new state of the art for multi-view reconstruction with known camera parameters.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型以顺序对顺序的方式运行,与现有的序列对一的MVS方法形成对比,后者也包含了相机引起的前科. 实验结果表明,它与MVS方法以及最近的序列到序列的反馈模型相比,取得了优异的重建成果,建立了具有已知相机参数的多景重建的新工艺水平.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Structure-from-Motion. Structure-from-Motion (SfM) [ 15 , 32 , 40 , 33 , 31 , 36 , 31 ] aims to jointly estimate camera parameters and sparse 3D structure from multi-view images. Classical pipelines, such as COLMAP [ 40 ] , Pix4D [ 36 ] and OpenMVG [ 31 ] , decompose the problem into stages including feature extraction, matching, triangulation, and bundle adjustment, and remain strong baselines under well-constrained settings [ 29 , 1 , 38 , 15 ] . Recent progress has focused on improving robustness through learned components, particularly in feature detection and matching. These include sparse matching pipelines with local feature detection [ 7 , 48 ] and matching [ 61 , 39 , 28 ] , and dense matching pipelines without feature detectors [ 45 , 47 , 9 , 10 ] . Beyond modular pipelines, end-to-end differentiable approaches such as VGGSfM [ 51 ] jointly optimize camera poses and scene structure, improving performance in challenging scenarios. Recently, VidMap [ 34 ] has been proposed for video-based SfM by leveraging temporal information. Nevertheless, dense reconstruction remains a challenge in this line of work, subject to expensive and complex post-processing steps [ 12 , 5 , 46 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 结构从运动。 结构-自动(SfM)[15,32,40,33,31,36,31]旨在从多视图图像中共同估计相机参数和稀疏的3D结构. 古典管线,如COLMAP [40],Pix4D [36]和OpenMVG [31] 将问题分解成阶段,包括地物提取,匹配,三角化,以及捆绑调整,在约束性强的环境下保持强基线[29, 1, 38, 15]. 最近的进展侧重于通过学习成份,特别是在特征检测和匹配方面,提高稳健性。 其中包括配对管道与局部特征检测[7,48]和配对[61,39,28],以及配对管道密度大而无特征检测器[45,47,9,10]. 除了模块化的管道外,VGGSfM[51]等端到端的异位方法联合优化了相机的姿势和场景结构,改善了挑战性情景中的性能. 最近,VidMap [34] 被提议通过利用时间信息进行基于视频的SfM. 尽管如此,密集的重建仍然是这项工作中的一个挑战,需要经过昂贵和复杂的后处理步骤[12、5、46、11]。

blocks.en: Learning-based Multi-View Stereo. Recent MVS methods are mostly learning-based [ 59 , 50 , 14 , 30 , 35 , 8 , 4 , 20 ] , focusing on dense reconstruction given calibrated cameras typically provided by SfM. Traditional methods rely on handcrafted priors or global optimization, while learning-based approaches, such as MVSNet [ 59 ] , leverage cost volumes and 3D convolutional networks to infer accurate depth maps. These models significantly improve reconstruction quality, particularly in challenging regions like texure-less structures or wide baselines. Recent work, including MVSA [ 20 ] , emphasizes generalization across diverse scenes and viewing conditions. Despite these advances, most MVS methods construct cost volumes on a per-view basis, limiting their ability to capture global scene structure. Moreover, their sequence-to-one formulation restricts predictions to a reference view, leaving multi-view consistency to be handled implicitly.
blocks.zh: 学习基础多维立体声. 近期的MVS方法大多以学习为主[59,50,14,30,35,8,4,20],注重给定的密密的重建,通常由SfM提供的校准相机. 传统方法依赖手工前科或全球优化,而基于学习的方法,如MVSNet[59],利用成本量和3D演化网络来推断准确的深度图. 这些模型大大提高了重建质量,特别是在有挑战性的区域,如无缝结构或宽基线。 包括MVSA[20]在内的近期作品强调跨不同场景和观看条件的概括. 尽管取得了这些进步,大多数MVS方法还是按每个视图构建成本量,限制了它们捕捉全球场景结构的能力. 此外,它们的顺序对一的表述将预测限制在参考观点上,使多观点的一致性被隐含地处理.

blocks.en: Feed-Forward Reconstruction. Feed-Forward approaches reformulate multi-view reconstruction as a direct prediction problem using neural networks, often built on transformer architectures. Early works focus on pairwise inputs, with methods such as DUSt3R [ 54 ] directly predicting aligned point maps without requiring camera parameters, and MASt3R [ 25 ] improving geometric consistency and scale estimation. Multi-view feed-forward models, including VGGT [ 52 ] , Fast3R [ 57 ] , MapAnything [ 23 ] , π 3 \pi^{3} [ 56 ] , DepthAnything3 [ 27 ] , VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 53 ] , and DVLT [ 2 ] , aggregate features across views using global attention to jointly estimate camera parameters and scene geometry in a single forward pass. However, global attention incurs quadratic complexity with respect to the number of input views, limiting scalability. Approaches such as FastVGGT [ 43 ] and SparseVGGT [ 49 ] improve efficiency through token reduction or sparse attention. Despite these advances, jointly estimating camera parameters and geometry remains highly challenging, and such models are usually prone to reconstruction inaccuracies or distortion.
blocks.zh: 饲前重建. Feed-Forward方法将多视图重建重塑为使用神经网络的直接预测问题,常建在变压器架构上. 早期的作品注重对偶输入,方法如DUST3R[54]直接预测对齐点图而不需要相机参数,以及MAst3R[25]改进几何一致性和尺度估计. 多视图的Feed-forward模型,包括VGGT [52],Fast3R [57],Map Anything [23], shile 3\pi^{3] [56],Dephing3 [27],VGGT-\Omega [53],以及DVLT [2],利用全球注意力在单个前传中联合估计相机参数和场景几何的全景特征. 然而,全球注意力在投入视图数量方面有四倍的复杂性,限制了可扩展性。 FastVGGT [43] 和SparseVGGT [49] 等方法通过象征性的减少或很少注意来提高效率. 尽管取得了这些进展,但联合估计相机参数和几何仍然极具挑战性,这种模型通常容易发生重建不准确或扭曲.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed sequence-to-sequence multi-view stereo method. For each input view, we extract view tokens using DINOv2 backbone, and incorporate camera-induced priors into the model with ray-map embeddings and global-cost-volume embeddings. The tokens are then fed into recurring attention layers to aggregate frame and global information, which are fed to Decoding heads to produce depth maps and point maps of each input view.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 拟议的顺序对顺序多视图立体法概述. 对于每个输入视图,我们使用DINOv2主干提取查看符,并将相机引发的前身与射线映射嵌入和全局成本容量嵌入纳入模型. 然后将符号输入经常性的注意层,以汇总框架和全球信息,然后输入解码头,以制作每个输入视图的深度图和点图。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we describe the proposed method, termed Sequence-to-Sequence MVS (S2S-MVS). We start by introducing the setting and formulating the addressed problem in Sec. 3.1 , as well as explaining the basic architecture of our framework. Then, we separately explain how the two camera-induced priors can be incorporated into our basic architecture in Sec. 3.2 and Sec. 3.3 .

blocks.en: Frame and Global Attention. Consistent with existing works [ 52 , 27 , 2 ] , our transformer architecture alternates between frame-wise self-attention and global self-attention. Frame-wise self-attention is applied to the tokens of each input image independently, which focuses on per-view scene information. Global self-attention is applied to all tokens across all input images, aggregating crucial multi-view information to facilitate reconstruction. In our work, we use a recurrent architecture for frame-wise and global attention following DVLT [ 2 ] , which drastically reduces the number of parameters.
blocks.zh: 框架和全球关注。 与现有作品[52,27,2]一致,我们的变压器架构在帧自觉和环球自觉之间交替. 框架自意被独立应用于每个输入图像的符号,它侧重于每个视图的场景信息. 全球自觉性适用于所有输入图像中的所有符号,汇总关键的多视图信息,以促进重建。 在我们的工作中,我们使用一个反复出现的架构,在DVLT[2]之后进行帧和全球关注,这极大地减少了参数的数量.

blocks.en: 3.2 Camera Parameter Encoding

blocks.en: Camera parameters are typically expressed in the literature in two ways. In VGGT [ 52 ] , camera tokens are defined for each frame and serve as special tokens that participate in both frame and global attentions. Alternatively, in DepthAnything3 [ 27 ] , a depth-ray representation is used as the regression objective.
blocks.zh: 相机参数一般在文献中以两种方式表达. 在VGGT [52]中,相机符号被定义为每个帧,并作为特殊标志,同时参与帧和全球关注. 或者,在深度任意3 [27] 中,深射线表示作为回归目标。

blocks.en: In our setting, we assume the camera parameters are known, which allows us to encode camera information from the beginning. We opt for a ray map embedding approach over camera tokens, which directly injects information in a per-patch manner and stabilizes training.
blocks.zh: 在我们的设定中,我们假设相机参数是已知的,这使我们能够从一开始就编码相机信息. 我们选择用射线图嵌入方法在相机标志上,它直接以每幅方式注入信息,稳定训练.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cost Volume Construction

blocks.en: Cost volume is a pivotal module in most existing learning-based MVS methods, providing crucial camera-induced scene priors for multi-view reconstruction. Next, we will explain the conventional cost volume construction first, then turn to our proposed global cost volume.
blocks.zh: 成本量是大多数现有基于学习的MVS方法中的一个关键模块,为多视图重建提供了关键的镜头引发场景前传. 其次,我们将首先解释常规成本量建设,然后谈谈我们拟议的全球成本量。

To capture low-level features from images, a convolutional backbone is usually used for cost volume construction, giving feature maps ( ℱ i ) i = 1 V (\mathcal{F}_{i})_{i=1}^{V} . The cost volume is constructed by warping feature maps ℱ i \mathcal{F}_{i} from each source view to the reference one using hypothesized depth values ( d i ) i = 1 T (d_{i})_{i=1}^{T} .

blocks.en: In sequence-to-sequence modeling, view-specific cost volumes become prohibitively expensive because the same process must be repeated for each view, which incentivizes us to present the global cost volume.

blocks.en: 3D Space Sampling. Sampling strategy in 3D space is a key design choice in MVS methods. Although uniform grid sampling usually works well if a 3D bounding box is given, there is no universally effective sampling method for unbounded scenes with no bounding box. In this work, we define a canonical sampling scheme described as follows.
blocks.zh: 3D空间采样. 3D空间的取样策略是MVS方法中的关键设计选择. 虽然统一的网格采样如果给出一个3D边框,通常效果很好,但是对于没有边框的无边框场景,并没有普遍有效的采样方法. 在这项工作中,我们界定了如下的犬类取样计划。

blocks.en: We first generate a set of hypothesized depth values ( d i ) i = 1 T (d_{i})_{i=1}^{T} based on the distances between the camera origins, following MVSA [ 20 ] which employs logarithmic sampling to deal with unboundness. View-specific sampled points are computed by reprojecting ( d i ) i = 1 T (d_{i})_{i=1}^{T} to 3D space with respect to each pixel for each view. We then define a global 3D frustum that encompasses all view-specific sampled points, which are sampled uniformly in x , y x,y axes and logarithmically in the z z axis to form a 3D sample grid. By applying Eq. ( 4 ) on the grid samples, we obtain a global cost volume 𝐂 \mathbf{C} .
blocks.zh: 我们首先根据相机来源的距离产生一套假设深度值(di)i=1T(d_{i}i}i=i=1}^{T}),遵循MVSA[20]使用对数采样处理无约束性. 视图特定采样点的计算方法是将(di) i = 1 T (d_{i}) i = 1}^{T = 3D 空间对每个视图的每个像素进行重新预测。 然后我们定义一个包含所有特定视图采样点的全局3D frustum,这些采样点在x,y x,y轴和对数的z z轴中被统一采样,形成3D采样网格. 通过在网格样本上应用Eq. (4 ),我们获得了全球成本量 C\ mathbf{C}.

blocks.en: In this way, cost values are computed only for a single expanded frustum, and view-specific cost volumes can be obtained by very efficient interpolation. As a result, we obtain view-specific cost volumes 𝐂 i \mathbf{C}_{i} shaped T × H s × W s T\times\frac{H}{s}\times\frac{W}{s} simply by interpolating 𝐂 \mathbf{C} .

blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: Training Data. We train our model on a large variety of datasets following MVSA [ 20 ] , including Hypersim [ 37 ] , TartanAIR [ 55 ] , BlendedMVG [ 60 ] , MatrixCity [ 26 ] , VKITTI2 [ 3 ] , DynamicReplica [ 22 ] , MVSSynth [ 19 ] , SAIL-VOS3D [ 17 , 18 ] . Our image encoder uses initialized weights from DINOv3 [ 44 ] , which was trained a large corpus of web images. For cost volume construction, we use the first block of ResNet18 [ 16 ] , producing feature maps at resolution H 4 × W 4 \frac{H}{4}\times\frac{W}{4} .
blocks.zh: 培训数据。 我们在MVSA [20] 之后的多种数据集上训练我们的模型,包括Hypersim [37],TartanAir [55],BlendedMVG [60],MatrixCity [26],VKITTI2 [3],Dynamic Replica [22],MVSSynth [19],SAIL-VOS3D [17,18]. 我们的图像编码器采用了来自DINOv3[44]的初始化的重量,它接受了大量网络图像的培训. 在成本量构建方面,我们使用ResNet18的第一块块[16],在H 4× W 4\frac{H}{4}\times\frac{W}{4}中制作地物图.

Training Loss. The model is trained with a cosine learning rate scheduler starting at 0.0001 0.0001 for 160 ​ k 160k iterations with a batch size of 2 2 . blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the performances of our model and the state-of-the-art competitors including both sequence-to-sequence and sequence-to-one methods on 3D reconstruction tasks. Following this, we will also present an ablation study to validate the effectiveness of the proposed ray-map embedding and global-cost-volume designs.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们评价我们模型的性能和最先进的竞争对手,包括三维重建任务的顺序对顺序和顺序对一方法. 在此之后,我们还将提出一项扩展研究,以验证拟议的射线图嵌入和全球成本量设计的有效性。

blocks.en: Baselines. Our main competitors are the feed-forward sequence-to-sequence methods, including VGGT [ 52 ] , Fast3R [ 57 ] , MapAnything [ 23 ] , Pi3 [ 56 ] , DepthAnything3 [ 27 ] , VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 53 ] and DVLT [ 2 ] . Among these methods, VGGT, Fast3R, VGGT- Ω \Omega and DVLT do not take camera parameters as input, we will use the estimated camera parameters to produce point maps in our evaluation. MapAnything, Pi3 and DepthAnything3 support camera parameters as input, we will additionally evaluate these models with ground truth camera parameters as input, to form direct and fair comparison against our method. All methods take the first-camera frame as the world frame. We also compare against MVSFormer++ [ 4 ] and MVSA [ 20 ] , which are the state-of-the-art sequence-to-one models to the best of our knowledge.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们的主要竞争对手是向导序列对序方法,包括VGGT [52], Fast3R [57], Map Anything [23], Pi3 [56], Depth Anything 3 [27], VGGT -\Omega [53] 和 DVLT [2] 。 在这些方法中,VGGT,Fast3R,VGGT-ship\Omega和DVLT不以相机参数作为输入,我们将使用估计的相机参数来制作我们评价中的点图. 作为输入,我们将以地面真实相机参数作为输入,对这些模型进行额外的评估,以便与我们的方法形成直接和公平的比较。 所有的方法都以第一镜头框架作为世界框架. 我们还比较了MVSFormer++[4]和MVSA[20],它们是我们所知最先进的序列对一模型.

blocks.en: Training Details. We use all the models pretrained on their respective datasets. Our training configuration follows MVSA. However, all the other models are trained on roughly 2-3 times more datasets than ours. In addition, most feed-forward models are trained on ScanNet dataset which is used in our evaluation, we therefore color-code their results on this dataset in gray.
blocks.zh: 训练详情。 我们使用所有预先训练的模型 在各自的数据集。 我们的训练配置跟随MVSA. 然而,所有其他模型都接受了大约2-3倍于我们数据集的培训。 此外,大多数向导的模型都是在ScanNet数据集上训练的,用于我们的评价,因此我们用灰色的颜色编码它们在这个数据集上的结果。

blocks.en: Benchmark. We use the RMVDB benchmark [ 42 ] to evaluate all methods, which consists of five multi-view datasets that are not included in our training dataset, i.e. KITTI [ 13 ] , ScanNet [ 6 ] , ETH3D [ 41 ] , DTU [ 21 ] and Tanks & Temples [ 24 ] . These datasets cover a diverse set of real-world scenarios, including driving sequences, room scans, building scans, and tabletop objects. We use all 8-frame tuples provided in the RMVDB for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基准。 我们使用 RMVDB 基准 [42] 来评价所有方法,它包括5个没有包括在我们训练数据集中的多视图数据集,即KITTI [13],ScanNet [6],ETH3D [41],DTU [21]和Tanks & Temples [24]. 这些数据集涵盖了一套多样的现实世界情景,包括驱动序列,房间扫描,建筑扫描,以及桌面物体. 我们用RMVDB中提供的所有8个框架的拖拉机进行评估。

blocks.en: Metrics. We use relative per-point errors between predicted and ground truth point maps to compute our main evaluation metric. To account for the different scales in different scenes, we first compute the scale of each predicted or ground truth point maps as the mean distance to the origin, and normalize the point maps accordingly before evaluation. Then the relative per-point error is computed as the point errors divided by the ground-truth depth of that point. We report the robust Area Under the Curve (AUC) statistics of the computed relative per-point errors at finer 0.05 0.05 and coarser 0.10 0.10 .
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们使用预测和地面真实点地图之间相对的每点差错来计算我们的主要评价指标。 为了说明不同场景中不同的比例尺,我们首先计算每张预测或地面真实点地图的比例尺,作为与起源的中间距离,并在评价前相应地使点图正常化. 然后,每个点的相对误差被计算为点差除以该点的地面真实深度. 我们报告曲线下强力区(AUC)统计数字,显示每点计算出更细0.05和更短0.100.10的相对误差。

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares our S2S-MVS with recent sequence-to-sequence feed-forward reconstruction models and sequence-to-one MVS models on the RMVDB benchmark. Overall, S2S-MVS achieves the best reconstruction accuracy on most datasets, obtaining the highest AUC.05/AUC.10 scores on ETH3D and KITTI and showing strong generalization to both indoor structured scenes and outdoor driving scenes. On DTU and Tanks&Temples, S2S-MVS remains highly competitive with the best-performing baselines across both metrics.
blocks.zh: 表1将我们的S2S-MVS与RMVDB基准上最近的序列对序反馈重建模型和序列对一的MVS模型进行比较. 总体而言,S2S-MVS在大多数数据集上都实现了最佳的重建精度,在ETH3D和KITTI上获得了最高的AUC.05/AUC.10分数,并对室内结构化场景和室外驾驶场景表现出强烈的概括. 在DTU和Tanks&Temples上,S2S-MVS仍然具有高度的竞争力,在两个衡量标准上都具有最佳的基线。

blocks.en: In addition to camera-free feed-forward methods, S2S-MVS also compares favorably to feed-forward and MVS methods that take camera parameters as input, demonstrating the effectiveness of our sequence-to-sequence MVS formulation. It is also worth noting that several baseline methods report strong performance on ScanNet; however, as indicated by the gray-color-coded entries, these models have been trained on ScanNet. In contrast, S2S-MVS is evaluated in a more challenging cross-dataset setting and still maintains competitive accuracy, outperforming the other MVS baselines (MVSFormer++ and MVSAnywhere) that were likewise not trained on this dataset.
blocks.zh: 除了无相机的Feed-forward方法外,S2S-MVS还比较了以相机参数作为输入的Feed-forward和MVS方法,证明了我们序列到序列的MVS配方的有效性. 还值得注意的是,若干基准方法报告了ScanNet的强效性能;然而,如灰色-彩色编码条目所示,这些模型已在ScanNet上接受了培训。 与此相反,S2S-MVS在更具挑战性的跨数据集设置中受到评价,并且仍然保持竞争性的准确性,比其他没有接受过此数据集培训的MVS基线(MVSFormer++和MVSAnywhere)表现优异.

blocks.en: We also compare runtime efficiency in Table 1 . S2S-MVS runs on par with the fastest sequence-to-sequence feed-forward models and substantially faster than heavier feed-forward pipelines. More importantly, compared with the sequence-to-one MVS baselines that achieve the closest reconstruction accuracy to ours, S2S-MVS is considerably faster than both MVSFormer++ and MVSAnywhere, while matching or exceeding their accuracy across most datasets. This shows that our sequence-to-sequence formulation combines the accuracy of dedicated MVS pipelines with the efficiency of feed-forward reconstruction models.
blocks.zh: 我们还比较了表1中的运行时间效率。 S2S-MVS的运行速度与速度最快的顺序到顺序的馈送型号相当,并且大大快于较重的馈送管道。 更重要的是,与实现最接近我们的重建精度的序列对一MVS基线相比,S2S-MVS比MVSFormer++和MVSAnywhere都快得多,同时在大多数数据集中匹配或超过其精度. 这表明,我们的测序配制结合了专用MVS输油管的精度和饲料前置重建模型的效率.

blocks.en: We also provide qualitative comparisons in Fig. 3 . In the figure, we compare with DepthAnything3 in both w/ and w/o camera settings, and visualize the predicted point maps overlaid with the gray-coded ground truth point maps. We can see that S2S-MVS produces more accurate reconstructions compared to other methods. The performance is more pronounced on the last scene in the figure from Tanks&Temples dataset, where the reconstructed geometries of other methods suffer from 3D anisotropic scale distortion, leading to an incorrect aspect ratio of the reconstructed scene. In contrast, our method does not suffer from this issue.
blocks.zh: 我们还提供了图3的质量比较。 在图中,我们与W/和W/o相机设置中的DepthAnything3进行对比,并用灰色编码的地面真理点地图来直观地映射所预测的点图. 我们可以看到,与其它方法相比,S2S-MVS能产生更准确的重建. 在Tanks&Temples数据集图中的最后一个场景中,性能更为明显,其中其他方法的重建的几何美因受到3D异构尺度的扭曲,导致重建场景的侧面比不正确. 与此相反,我们的方法并不受这一问题的影响。

blocks.zh: 4.2 进一步分析

blocks.en: Global Alignment. The benefit of the sequence-to-sequence design of S2S-MVS is that it can achieve better global alignment of the reconstructed geometry across views, as the model can directly learn to reason about the global geometry from the input image sequences. In contrast, sequence-to-one methods like MVSA reconstruct each view independently, which can lead to misalignment issues across views. We provide a qualitative comparison in Fig. 4 , where we visualize the predicted point maps from S2S-MVS and MVSA, where our method produces more globally consistent reconstructions across views.
blocks.zh: 全球对齐。 S2S-MVS的序列到序列设计的好处在于它可以实现重建的几何跨视图更好的全球对齐,因为模型可以从输入图像序列中直接学习来解释全球几何. 相比之下,像MVSA这样的顺序对一方法独立地重建了每个视图,这可能导致不同观点的错位问题. 我们在图4中提供了质的比较,我们从S2S-MVS和MVSA中可视化预测的点图,我们的方法可以产生更加全球一致的各种不同观点的重建。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose S2S-MVS, a novel sequence-to-sequence feed-forward model for multi-view stereo reconstruction. Our model is designed to directly predict point maps for each view from input image sequences, assuming camera parameters to be known. We introduce a ray-map embedding design to encode the camera information of the input views, and a global cost volume design to provide strong regularization for geometry prediction. We evaluate our model on the RMVDB benchmark, and show that it achieves superior reconstruction accuracy compared to state-of-the-art sequence-to-sequence feed-forward models, and comparable performance to the best sequence-to-one model while being significantly faster. However, compared to other feed-forward models, our model is still limited by the scale of training data and thus does not generalizes well in certain scenarios. Nonetheless, we believe that our S2S-MVS model provides a promising direction for efficient and accurate multi-view stereo reconstruction, and can be further improved by exploring more advanced architectures and training strategies.
